name: PublishTerraformPlan
description: Publish a Terraform binary plan with generated JSON, or publish an existing JSON plan as a build artifact.
author: Freeson Li
helpMarkDown: Always provide jsonFile. With planFile, generate JSON at that path and publish both files using the same Terraform version and initialized directory. Without planFile, publish the existing JSON without Terraform. Plan files can contain unredacted sensitive values; artifact access follows the pipeline's permissions.

inputs.name: planFile
inputs.label: Binary plan file (optional)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Existing binary plan created by terraform plan -out. Relative paths resolve against Working directory. The artifact preserves the binary file's name. Leave empty to publish an existing jsonFile without running Terraform.

inputs.name: jsonFile
inputs.label: JSON plan file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Required path ending in .plan.json. With planFile, generate JSON at this path, replacing an existing file after successful conversion and validation. Without planFile, this file must already exist. Relative paths resolve against Working directory. The artifact preserves this file's name.

inputs.name: artifactName
inputs.label: Artifact name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Build artifact containing the plan files. Use a distinct name for each invocation in a run.

inputs.name: workingDirectory
inputs.label: Working directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Base directory for relative input paths. For binary conversion, use the initialized Terraform directory including its provider plugins.

inputs.name: terraformCliPath
inputs.label: Terraform CLI path (optional)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the Terraform executable for binary conversion. Leave empty to use terraform from PATH. Use the version that created the binary plan. Ignored when publishing existing JSON.
